observed_outcome: Benchmark and concurrency under load evaluated against real parallel connections on PostgreSQL 18.6 (P1a-WP7 SC-07 baseline). Concurrency, lease/fencing (C15, P1a-WP4), commit-order outbox relay (C33, P1a-WP3), and 20-stream concurrent relay/producer execution verified. Full production gate P5 remains pending P2a-WP5 (C35), P2a-WP6 (C34, C39), and DG-5 performance threshold evaluation.
